steps.control: Enable and server-verify four capabilities in policy order; suspend and recover workspace; guarded rollback and re-verification; global suspension and recovery
steps.reconciliation: release, workspace, capability, verification, suspension and immutable audit rows match displayed versions
steps.cleanup: restore the protected release baseline after governed lifecycle cleanup

steps.control: Parse and review 110 rows; Import 110 reviewed items
steps.expected: one atomic complete import or typed unchanged failure
steps.reconciliation: one import, 110 ledger items, counts and hash agree
steps.stop: row count/hash mismatch, partial products, replay conflict
steps.cleanup: archive correlation-bound imported fixtures after dependent cleanup

steps.expected: preferred and approved alternate offers are internally visible
steps.reconciliation: products/offers reference import and contain no outbound event
steps.stop: unresolved product, retailer, category or offer

steps.reconciliation: package tenant, version and rooms match
steps.stop: wrong tenant or unbound command context

steps.expected: incomplete approval denied, completed package approved
steps.reconciliation: version, validation issues, approval snapshot and audit agree
steps.stop: approval with unresolved issue or changed replay

steps.control: Select package/products; use alternate; review; submit
steps.expected: controlled project only; approved selections and budget
steps.reconciliation: tenant, rooms, selections, totals and revisions agree
steps.stop: cross-tenant package, arbitrary offer or stale version accepted

steps.expected: one immutable snapshot; exact replay returns existing
steps.reconciliation: content hash, normalized items, package and plan lineage agree
steps.stop: mutable snapshot or duplicate changed replay
steps.cleanup: retained as audit lineage until project cleanup policy permits archival

steps.reconciliation: snapshot ID/hash/version and baseline lines agree
steps.stop: legacy source chosen when snapshot exists or ambiguous lineage
steps.cleanup: close baseline after receipts and budget reconcile

steps.reconciliation: approved, committed, actual and available sum exactly
steps.cleanup: terminal reconciliation to zero open commitment

steps.control: Prepare a bounded internal batch without recording an order or provider reference
steps.expected: internal preparation only; no retailer or external-order consequence
steps.reconciliation: batch lines, versions, authorization and budget reservation agree
steps.stop: provider call, retailer contact, external order, payment or duplicate batch

steps.control: Record receipt; resolve discrepancy; record completion
steps.expected: partial receipt creates discrepancy; resolution permits complete receipt
steps.reconciliation: receipts, accepted quantities, exception state and line status agree
steps.stop: over-receipt, missing discrepancy or non-idempotent replay
steps.cleanup: resolve all discrepancies and close lines

steps.expected: customer-safe progress; no mutation or internal fields
steps.stop: Admin control, reason, audit, provider or internal evidence visible

steps.control: Engage the global kill switch, invoke designation-bound cleanup, reconcile and replay its manifest, then revoke the cohort
steps.expected: transactional archival of enumerated controlled rows; immutable evidence retained; replay returns the original result
steps.reconciliation: every manifest count matches before/after queries, zero external effects, designation cleaned and revoked, kill switch engaged
steps.stop: missing/mismatched designation, dependency, count mismatch, authenticated invocation, or mutation after the kill switch
steps.cleanup: this is the terminal service-only cleanup action
